analyst_view.overall: Early view: Oviedo are ninth under Julián Calero after a 2-1 win at Cádiz, though they were outplayed on chances there, and one report said striker Chris Ramos tore a cruciate ligament in September. Celta Fortuna are 16th, lost 2-1 at Burgos with only one shot on target and have four players on five yellows; three of them should serve bans at Albacete on 16 November.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean lower: Oviedo's home games have averaged only two goals, and without Chris Ramos their attack relies on wide players such as Ilyas Chaira and Estanis. Celta Fortuna's defence is weak (25 conceded), so Oviedo should still score.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners. Celta Fortuna gave up 10 corners and won none at Burgos, which supports a high home share, so the total looks right.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.2 cards. I lean higher: Celta Fortuna had four yellows at Burgos and four players have reached five yellows already, and Oviedo took five yellows at Cádiz.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.6 shots, which looks too high. Oviedo took 12 shots at Cádiz and Celta Fortuna only six at Burgos, so I expect something in the mid 20s.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target. I lean lower: Oviedo had four on target at Cádiz and Celta Fortuna one at Burgos, and Oviedo's striker shortage limits their output.
